clue.text: Scorer defining route for lexicographer

indicators.note: to define is to mark out the bounds of something, so the composer's name encloses the route

parts.note: Carl Maria von Weber, the German composer, wrote scores
ST is the abbreviation for street, a route

explanation.surface: A goal-scorer mapping out a route for a dictionary maker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scorer' suggests sport, but in this film-music puzzle it is a composer, Weber.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah Webster compiled the famous American dictionary, so he is a lexicographer by name.

clue.text: Good and bad

explanation.surface: A tiny paradox: something both good and bad.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means evil in standard use, and in slang it means excellent, so it covers both opposites.

clue.text: Queen, perhaps, wrapping up problem puzzle

indicators.note: wrapping means the insect's letters go round the reversed sum

parts.note: a queen is one kind of bee

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: The Queen tackling a tricky problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen, perhaps' looks royal, but it is a queen bee.
explanation.definitionFit: To bemuse someone is to confuse or perplex them, a verb synonym of puzzle.

clue.text: Authority in control, he has contract for renegotiation

indicators.note: a contract up for renegotiation will be reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A figure in charge who has a contract up for renegotiation.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranging HE and CONTRACT gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A technocrat is a technical expert who holds power, an authority running things by expertise.

clue.text: Pin I check under top of roof

indicators.note: in a down clue, I and the check sit below the roof's top letter
the top of a word in a down clue is its first letter

parts.note: to vet is to check or examine

explanation.surface: Someone pinning things and checking them beneath a roof.
explanation.definitionFit: A rivet is a metal pin used to fasten plates together.

clue.text: Catchy thing, 16th incantation?

parts.note: a mantra is a chanted incantation
P is the sixteenth letter of the alphabet, as if mantras were labelled A, B, C...

explanation.surface: A catchy tune that is the sixteenth chant in a series.
explanation.walkthrough: Think of a list of mantras labelled MANTRA A, MANTRA B and so on; the sixteenth is MANTRA P.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantrap is a device for catching trespassers, so it is literally a thing that catches.

clue.text: Right image adopted by greater Italian scorer

indicators.note: being adopted means being taken in, so these letters go inside the word for greater

parts.note: more means greater
an icon is an image

explanation.surface: A proper image taken up by a greater Italian goal-scorer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scorer' again suggests football, but Ennio Morricone composed film scores, and he is the puzzle's theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennio Morricone was an Italian composer famous for film scores, so he is a scorer in the musical sense.

clue.text: Only off for 12

parts.note: if the light switch reads only off

explanation.surface: A switch with only an off setting, for twelve o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: Treat the answer as NO ON: a world with only off has no on.
explanation.definitionFit: Midday is twelve o'clock, so the number 12 stands for the middle of the day.

clue.text: Install new parts, strong girder finally put up over it

indicators.note: in a down clue, the reversed letters sit above the pronoun
in a down clue, put up means these letters are raised so they read from bottom to top

parts.note: forte is the musical term for loud and strong

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of girder

explanation.surface: Fitting new parts: a strong girder is hoisted over something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' raises FORTE plus R, giving RETROF, placed over IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrofit is to install new components into something already built.

clue.text: See 19
Joker somewhat caustic, I'm occasionally contrary

indicators.note: contrary means running the opposite way, so the letters are read backwards
somewhat signals only part of the words is taken

explanation.surface: A joker who is somewhat biting and now and then perverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occasionally' is part of the hidden text, not an alternate-letter signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic is a comedian, someone who tells jokes for a living.

clue.text: Rats dropping in, tenor distraught, one in a state?

indicators.note: dropping the little word in means it is removed from the pests

parts.note: rats are vermin

indicators.note: a distraught tenor is all over the place, so his letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Rats drop in on a singer who is upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distraught' turns TENOR into ONTER. The question mark flags that the 'state' is a US state, not a state of distress.
explanation.definitionFit: A Vermonter lives in Vermont, one of the United States, so is one person in a state.

clue.text: Film director requires great intellect to capture scene after evacuation

indicators.note: capturing means the genius's name holds the other letters inside

parts.note: Albert Einstein's name is used for any great genius

indicators.note: a word evacuated has its insides emptied out, leaving only the outer letters

explanation.surface: A film director who needs a great mind to capture a scene once it is cleared.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergei Eisenstein was the Soviet film director of Battleship Potemkin.

clue.text: President is cross

definitions.meaning: to cross a river by wading at a shallow point

explanation.surface: A head of state who is angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like an adjective meaning angry but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Gerald Ford was a US President, and to ford a stream is to wade across it.

clue.text: Scorer sent in, as doubled up in torment

indicators.note: letters in torment are twisted about, so they are rearranged
doubled up means the little word as is taken twice

explanation.surface: A goal-scorer sent on as a substitute, doubled up in agony.
explanation.walkthrough: Camille Saint-Saëns was a French composer; his Carnival of the Animals was used in a film.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint-Saëns was a composer, a writer of musical scores, hence a scorer.

clue.text: As swine in decay, they can't fly

indicators.note: in means these letters sit inside the decay

parts.note: caries is tooth decay
a sow is a female pig, a swine

explanation.surface: Like pigs in rot, these animals cannot take off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'they can't fly' recalls the saying that pigs can't fly.
explanation.definitionFit: Cassowaries are large flightless birds of New Guinea and Australia.

clue.text: Most insignificant languages ultimately easiest to pick up

indicators.note: ultimately takes the final letter of languages

parts.note: the lightest thing weighs least, so it is easiest to lift

explanation.surface: The most trivial languages are, in the end, the easiest to learn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pick up' suggests learning a language; here it means lifting.
explanation.definitionFit: The slightest is the smallest or least important, a superlative synonym of most insignificant.

clue.text: Pitch business with regret after turning up to see Brussels official

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the letters read from the bottom upwards
after puts the regret behind the pitch and business

parts.note: tar is pitch
CO is short for company, a business
to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A sales pitch and some regret before showing up to meet an EU official.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses TARCORUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A Eurocrat is a bureaucrat of the European Union, which is based in Brussels.

clue.text: Group meeting bending over to welcome Lutheran leader

indicators.note: welcoming someone means taking them in, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: a concave surface curves over inwards

indicators.note: a leader is the front letter of Lutheran

explanation.surface: A gathering bowing to welcome a Lutheran leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A conclave is a private meeting, most famously the gathering of cardinals that elects a pope.

clue.text: See 21
One of 5 down's ideas, a Roman pic for composition

indicators.note: a composition puts things together in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A composer's idea for a Roman picture to set to music.
explanation.walkthrough: Morricone (5 down) scored the film Cinema Paradiso.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinema Paradiso is a 1988 Italian film with a score by Ennio Morricone.

clue.text: Agreement is working under alliance of nations

indicators.note: in a down clue, the other letters sit beneath the alliance

parts.note: UN is the United Nations
on means working, as a machine is on

explanation.surface: An accord at work beneath an international alliance.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in unison means acting in concord, with full agreement.

clue.text: Point to the new 19 and use new one of 5 down's

indicators.note: new signals that the letters are given a fresh arrangement

parts.note: 19 down's answer begins with the word for the pictures, picture house

explanation.surface: Pointing someone to a new picture house and using it.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'new' is fodder; the second is the anagram signal. 19 contributes CINEMA, the first word of 19 down.
explanation.definitionFit: Once Upon a Time in the West is Sergio Leone's 1968 Western, scored by Ennio Morricone.

clue.text: One of 5 down's is Jerusalem, with those people at the front

indicators.note: at the front puts the people before the other pieces

parts.note: them means those people
Sion (Zion) is a name for Jerusalem

explanation.surface: Jerusalem with a crowd at the head of it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mission is a 1986 film with a celebrated Morricone score.

clue.text: Films to avoid, including Terminator for a start

indicators.note: including means the letter sits inside the word for avoid

parts.note: to miss is to avoid

indicators.note: for a start takes the first letter of Terminator

explanation.surface: A list of films to skip, starting with The Terminator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Films' looks like movies but is a noun for thin coatings, like hazes.
explanation.definitionFit: Mists are thin films of vapour or droplets, as on a window or lens.

clue.text: Foul conclusion in contest, ugly

indicators.note: in places the end letter inside the word for contest

parts.note: to vie is to contest or compete

indicators.note: a word's conclusion is its final letter

explanation.surface: A foul at the end of a match turns ugly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foul' wants to be the definition; its conclusion gives L and the definition is 'ugly'.
explanation.definitionFit: Vile means unpleasant or hideous, a close synonym of ugly.

clue.text: Being prepared, add last of sauce to sardines in a stew

indicators.note: in a stew means flustered and mixed up, so the letters are rearranged
last of takes the final letter of sauce

explanation.surface: A recipe: add sauce to sardines in a stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a stew' looks like cookery but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Readiness is the state of being ready, being prepared.

clue.text: Chance rugby game won't start

indicators.note: not starting means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: sevens is rugby with seven players a side

explanation.surface: A rugby match that may not go ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Evens is a betting term for even odds, a fifty-fifty chance.

clue.text: See 21
Shame to shackle American bear

indicators.note: shackling holds something in, so these letters go inside

parts.note: a stain is a mark of shame

explanation.surface: A disgrace that shackles an American bear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bear' looks like the animal but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain a load is to bear or support it.
